title: The Crucible
summary: Trapped on Eriadu with the Empire closing in, the heroes fight their way out of the lower sumps and off-world. As they reach the rendezvous coordinates, the Resurgence drops out of hyperspace — and a Star Destroyer follows. Draco intercepts Denia's escape pod. The heroes watch the Resurgence die, TIE fighters swarming the survivors, and are forced to jump to hyperspace with nothing.

marks.label: The Lower Sumps
marks.desc: Fight your way through Eriadu's industrial underworld to reach the surface.

marks.label: Breaking Atmosphere
marks.desc: Get off-world with the Empire hunting you through the orbital cordon.

marks.label: The Resurgence Falls
marks.desc: Watch the Resurgence die. There's nothing you can do — and the cost of carrying that lands on you, not the people you couldn't save.

marks.label: Denia's Capture
marks.desc: Draco takes Denia in front of you. The choice is whether you go after her now or carry her absence into what comes next.

paths.label: Swear pursuit — Denia is the next priority
paths.desc: You name her name on the Banshee's deck and write the next move around her. Adv9 is yours to walk.

paths.label: Carry the loss into the run
paths.desc: There is no time for her tonight. You carry her absence the way you carry the Resurgence's dead — as weight you owe but cannot yet pay.

marks.label: The Survivors
marks.desc: Recover what you can from the wreckage. People, supplies, hope.

paths.label: Pull many out — the wider net
paths.desc: You delay your jump, you take the load, you fly heavy. More survive. The Empire gets closer to catching you for it.

paths.label: Pull the critical few — the surgical hand
paths.desc: You pick the survivors who carry the most forward — the codes, the keys, the names. Fewer live. The cause moves further.

marks.label: Naming Yourselves in the Dark
marks.desc: On the blind jump from the Resurgence's grave, the crew names themselves out loud — not as fugitives, not as runners, but as the thing the Empire could not kill at Eriadu. The name is the claim. Whatever the crew is on the other side of this jump, the Western Reaches will hear it as authority.

marks.label: The Truth You Carry
marks.desc: On the blind jump from the Resurgence's grave, the crew names what they now know about Varth, the Leviathan, and what Tarkin is building. Naming it commits the crew to carrying that truth out of the campaign — to Mothma, to Bail, to whoever can use it.

marks.label: Into the Void
marks.desc: Jump to hyperspace with nothing. No ship, no base, no safety net.

marks.label: The Crucible
marks.desc: The plan catastrophically fails. Improvise under fire to survive.

gearNotes.reason: Personal trials and reckoning imply combat and consequences. Medical supplies are always non-negotiable.
If alliances are being tested, secure communications between party members and allies become critical. Trust is the theme — intercepted comms could shatter it.
If alliances are being tested, recording conversations as evidence or insurance could be the difference between proving loyalty and being framed.
Personal trials may involve deception, infiltration, or hiding identity. Context-dependent on the specific trials.
The Reckoning implies a climactic confrontation. Combat recovery between scenes.

encounters.name: Beat 1 — Blind Jump from the Resurgence
encounters.trigger: Resurgence destroyed, Banshee jumps with no destination
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The blind jump beat. Maya keys a randomized vector to escape the Imperial pursuit. The Banshee comes out of hyperspace in unmapped space — quiet, dark, no nearby systems. The crew has time, no destination, and Denia in Imperial custody. To be expanded in build-out.

encounters.name: Beat 2 — Taking Stock
encounters.trigger: Maya secures the ship in deep space
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The crew counts what they have. Fuel for fewer jumps than they need. Rations for two weeks. One injured PC. The Resistance fleet is gone. Denia is gone. The campaign is at its lowest point. Reserve a conversation overlay slot for whichever NPC anchors the next move (likely Maya or a returning Varth-via-comm if the build-out chooses).
encounters.tactics: NO DICE — assessment scaffold. Conversation slot reserved.

encounters.name: Beat 3 — Where Do We Go
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The decision beat. Options: Black Spire / Batuu (sets up adv8), the Outer Rim Resistance cell, or somewhere off-narrative. The crew's call. Adv7 build-out should make this beat the explicit setup for the adv8 Iron Blockade arc.
